title: Rewrite mart_gpu_model_summary for the unpivoted fct_compute_offers
body:
## Parent

Part of #1 (Spec: Rewrite Downstream Marts for the Unpivoted fct_compute_offers)

## What to build

Rewrite `mart_gpu_model_summary` to operate on the unpivoted `fct_compute_offers` fact table. Group by (offer_type, gpu_architecture, gpu_model_name, tflops_per_gpu, gpu_memory_gb, tariff tier) with a single `pct_profitable` column — the share of current offers with `profit_usd_per_hr > 0` for that tier. Each row carries the tariff tier context (`tariff_tier_skey`, `consumer_category`, `tariff_window_type`, `tariff_block_number`) and retains `pct_verified`, `pct_available`, `avg_reliability_score`, `avg_kwh_per_tflop`, `avg_revenue_per_gpu_usd_per_hr`, and `last_seen_at`.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] The mart groups by (offer_type, gpu_architecture, gpu_model_name, tflops_per_gpu, gpu_memory_gb, tariff tier) for current offers only
- [ ] A single `pct_profitable` column reports the share of offers with `profit_usd_per_hr > 0` for that tier
- [ ] Each row carries `tariff_tier_skey`, `consumer_category`, `tariff_window_type`, `tariff_block_number`
- [ ] The mart retains `pct_verified`, `pct_available`, `avg_reliability_score`, `avg_kwh_per_tflop`, `avg_revenue_per_gpu_usd_per_hr`, and `last_seen_at`

## Blocked by

None — can start immediately
